findings.what: Rate limiter keys on the leftmost client-controlled X-Forwarded-For value; spoofing it bypasses /book rate limits (limiter is also in-memory per instance).
Claim-then-send gives at-most-once delivery: a crash between the claim UPDATE and the send loses that reminder permanently.
Reassign does not check the new doctor's working hours or whether the appointment is in the past.
Staff override skips all availability checks, including past dates.
Every appointment is fixed at 15 minutes; service.duration_minutes is ignored.
Custom grid replaces the Schedule-X resource view named in PRD §8.1; receptionists get only a day view, not today plus week.
Appointments booked less than 24h ahead never get a reminder (grace-window skip), and this is not surfaced to the user.
